summary_markdown: A discussion regarding the feasibility of installing sensors in Fisketorvet to capture internet data from a specific Wi-Fi network (SCTVNET). The plan involves testing the equipment, potentially at the office or directly at Fisketorvet. Concerns were raised about necessary firewalls for the Mall location.
decisions: The team will set up and test a sensor either in the office or at Fisketorvet tomorrow.
action_items: Determine if the equipment needs to be delivered to Gamel Mont this week.
Address firewall requirements for the Mall location during testing.
